The '''Teloc Ol-sen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Eclorar sector/Legends|Eclorar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teloc Ol-sen]].
